traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and detailed requirements in docs/stories/008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX.story.md are fully implemented and verified. The require-story-annotation and valid-annotation-format rules provide safe, limited auto-fix behavior (adding placeholder @story comments and normalizing @story path suffixes), with explicit configuration for templates and a per-rule autoFix toggle. Dedicated tests in tests/rules/auto-fix-behavior-008.test.ts directly cover REQ-AUTOFIX-MISSING, REQ-AUTOFIX-FORMAT, REQ-AUTOFIX-TEMPLATE, and REQ-AUTOFIX-SELECTIVE, while broader rule and integration tests ensure safety, preservation of formatting, and correct integration with the ESLint toolchain. The user-facing API reference documents these capabilities and their constraints. The full Jest suite passes, confirming the implementation is complete and stable for this story.
